Recent discovery highlights:
- Security folks: "secure-by-default" requirement; FIPS-approved HSMs mandatory for production payment flows.

- Infra: worried about call latency when every token encryption/decryption hits KMS; asked about local envelope key caching and KMS proxy patterns.
